handoff.salientSummary: Implemented PostgreSQL schema migration with 6 tables (evaluations, models, datasets, results, predictions, logs) including CHECK constraints, foreign keys, indexes, JSONB columns, and auto-update triggers. All verification steps passed.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Created migrations/001_init_schema.sql with complete database schema for LLM evaluation backend. Tables include: evaluations (task records with status tracking, UUID id, JSONB config, timestamp fields with auto-update triggers), models (CHECK constraints on type IN ('api','local') and provider IN ('openai','anthropic','dashscope','qwen','custom')), datasets (evaluation dataset definitions), results (JSONB metrics, foreign key to evaluations), predictions (per-sample predictions with foreign keys and NOT NULL constraints), logs (execution logs with JSONB metadata). Created indexes on evaluations.status, evaluations.created_at DESC, and foreign key columns. Implemented triggers for automatic updated_at timestamps and status transition timestamps (started_at on 'running', completed_at on terminal states). Pre-populated 9 default models (GPT-4, Claude, Qwen variants) and 5 datasets (MMLU, HellaSwag, HumanEval, GSM8K, C-Eval).

commandsRun.observation: Build successful, tests pass with 0.0% coverage (no test files exist yet for schema)

Table shows 11 columns: id (UUID), model_id (UUID FK), dataset_ids (UUID[]), config (JSONB), status (VARCHAR CHECK), progress (INTEGER CHECK), error_message, created_at (TIMESTAMP NOT NULL), updated_at (TIMESTAMP NOT NULL), started_at, completed_at. Indexes on status and created_at. Foreign key to models. Triggers for timestamps.

Table shows CHECK constraints: models_type_check (type IN ('api','local')), models_provider_check (provider IN ('openai','anthropic','dashscope','qwen','custom')). Unique constraint on name. Foreign key reference from evaluations.
